subject: Build Playwright QA harness (fixture server + screenshot script)
detail: Create qa/fixture-server.mjs (serves built web UI + canned snapshot over /ws + /api endpoints) and qa/screenshot.mjs (Playwright captures of all key UI states into qa/screenshots/). Install playwright.

subject: Push screenshot gallery panel to Clyde UI
detail: Run the QA harness to produce screenshots, then push_panel an image-gallery watching qa/screenshots/*.png.

subject: Fix UI issues revealed by screenshots
detail: Read the captured PNGs, identify visual bugs/rough edges, fix them, re-run the harness to verify.

subject: Server: mirror harness task ids so TaskUpdate matches (needs restart)
detail: agentSession.ts observeToolCall: TaskCreate input has no id (server invents a UUID) but TaskUpdate sends taskId "1"/"2"… so statuses never update — visible in 09-live-dogfood.png (all tasks ○ despite one in_progress). Fix: parse the TaskCreate tool_result text ("Task #N created") to capture the real id, or correlate via toolUseId on the result event. DO NOT apply while a live session runs under tsx watch — editing server src restarts the process and kills the session.

subject: Server: sort gallery files ascending by name (needs restart)
detail: server.ts expandGlob returns results.sort().reverse() so numbered captures display 09→01 in the live panel; qa/fixture-server.mjs already sorts ascending. Align the real server to ascending. Same restart caveat as the task-id fix.

subject: Composer attachments: drag-drop + paste + file picker with previews
detail: Upload endpoint saves to .clyde/uploads/; send_message carries attachment paths; agent gets "read these files" note; Slack-style thumbnail chips below the textarea and in sent bubbles.

subject: Work bar: prominent working/idle state + elapsed timer above composer
detail: Slim status bar between conversation and composer: pulsing dot + "working · 2m41s" ticking timer while a turn runs, green "idle — ready" otherwise; replaces the tiny composer status pill.

subject: FIFO message delivery: drain queue before new/idle deliveries
detail: enqueue on idle delivers new items directly, jumping persisted/queued older messages (user saw reordering). Fix: all non-urgent messages join the queue and drain FIFO; steering flushes queued items mid-turn in order before the newest; boot drains leftovers. Urgent deliberately jumps the queue.

subject: Auto-scroll conversation: follow new content unless reading history
detail: Jump to bottom on load; pin-to-bottom follows new events/deltas when already near the bottom; own main-flow sends always scroll; scrolling up unpins so history reading is never yanked.

subject: Auto-resume cut-short turns after server restart
detail: On resume boot with an empty queue: if the event log tail shows the last main-flow user_message has no turn_complete after it and the log is fresh (<30min), enqueue a visible [Auto-resume] continue message. Skip if the cut-short turn was itself an auto-resume (crash-loop guard). User chose option 2 because Clyde-builds-Clyde restarts the backend constantly.

subject: Tasks panel: edit subject/status, dispatch preview (R1 remainder)
detail: Editing DONE (066d304, wave-3 train): ✎ edit in the expanded card — subject/detail/status form, edit_task wire message, server applies + ONE debounced [Tasks edited] note to the agent (mirrors [Goal updated]); 01c-task-edit capture. Dispatch preview DECLINED under the stretch-real ruling (recorded in DECISIONS.md 2026-08-18): the UI cannot honestly render the brief the coordinator would write — it becomes real when a dispatch-from-task flow exists (SCOPE §panel-1 keeps it as direction).

subject: Goal doc editable in place, agent notified on save (R3 remainder)
detail: Edit SCOPE.md in the goal tab → save to file → agent notified it changed. Needs a save endpoint + file-watch note into the conversation. Riding with the #21 agent (one unit: the Goal panel moves left AND becomes editable). DONE (wave-B merge): Edit button in the (left-rail) Goal panel -> POST /api/goal writes SCOPE.md, goal broadcast to all clients, agent notified with a +N/-M note. Smoke-tested live on scratch: file written, notification turn delivered.

subject: Fold review items into Tasks per lifecycle-test decision (R4 follow-up)
detail: DONE with #19 (fbb1d17, wave-3 train) as designed: TaskItem carries source {review,item} + batch + declined/declineReason; the Reviews tab renders intake batches as burn-downs over tasks (settled = completed + declined) with legacy markdown checklists beneath.

subject: New-session action in the UI (R5 remainder)
detail: Done in 60179b2: top-bar button with inline confirm → new_session WS action → AgentSession.dispose() (abort SDK query, stop watcher, mute emits) + fresh ClydeStore + rebroadcast hello. Tasks/decisions/panels persist; threads/queue/events are per-session. Live-fire verified via qa/live-drive.mjs (conversation emptied, fresh round-trip OK).

subject: Plumb the real AskUserQuestion tool (R10)
detail: Add the "ask" permission rule so canUseTool fires under bypassPermissions; render 1–4 questions as an option card (2–4 options, Other free-text, multiSelect, previewFormat html); return {behavior:"allow", updatedInput:{questions, answers}} keyed by exact question text; blocking mode for load-bearing forks, non-blocking experiment otherwise; standing orders: ask early with a recommendation; distill answers into DECISIONS/tasks. Not available in subagents. UI per the attention-surface ruling: the question card renders in the RIGHT WORKBENCH (first test of that workflow), attention-badged, not as conversation clutter.

subject: UI/UX redesign wave against the Design Vision references
detail: Done in 1220d07 + 7a7d0f0 (break-glass session): design tokens per vision §6, shell (top bar / icon rail / capability panel / workbench), NEW Decisions panel, Tasks v2, git+conversation restyle, 18-state fixture QA + live-drive verification. See .clyde/HANDOFF.md for the full account; polish continues via the user's browser round.

subject: Backfill event-log holes after restarts (lost turn tails)
detail: PRIORITY RAISED 2026-08-18: second confirmed loss — the attention-surface acknowledgement prose vanished for the user during the #15 restart window; losing acknowledgements erodes trust in the document. A restart can kill the server before it consumes the tail of the SDK stream: the agent's last messages/tool calls execute but never reach events.jsonl, leaving a hole in the document (observed: a sidebar reply + TaskCreate #16 vanished; user saw it stream live, then it disappeared on reload). Fix: on resume boot, read the SDK's own session transcript (~/.claude/projects/<hash>/<sessionId>.jsonl), find messages after the last logged event, and translate+append them before starting the new query. Also: sequence intentional restarts (like the tasks.json reload touch) behind stream quiescence. DONE (merged 4215a68): backfill.ts plans from the CLI transcript on resume boot; sdkUuid stamped on all live events; 25 offline checks in qa/backfill-check.mjs (npm run qa:backfill). Proved live on its first boot — recovered the merge-train narrative the crash swallowed. Left out: quiescence-sequenced intentional restarts; mid-log holes older than the tail are unrecoverable by design.

subject: Threads metaphor: start threads anywhere, one noun (review items 4+5)
detail: Unify comments/threads into one noun: Threads. (a) Start a thread off any top-level message without selecting text — including the user's own messages; (b) keep the select-text affordance as an entry flow that seeds the thread with the highlighted quote; (c) preserve multiple threads per message anchored to different highlighted spans (user relies on this). Needs shared ThreadAnchor to make quote/span optional + server compose/anchor handling + web entry points (hover affordance on messages). DONE (merged 4215a68): ThreadAnchor span fields optional (quote present ⇔ span thread); hover ⊕ Thread affordance on every top-level message incl. the user's own; quoteless injection references the anchored message with a 200-char excerpt; multi-span threads per message preserved untouched; 04b-message-thread QA capture.

subject: Review ceremony: intake mode → distill → ask → Tasks with provenance
detail: DONE (fbb1d17 + hardening 9faa39a, wave-3 train), exactly per the settled design: ☰ Review arms the composer; the dump saves verbatim to .clyde/reviews/<batch>.md AT ENQUEUE (survives restarts); delivery injects the ceremony script (distill → echo → one clarifying AskUserQuestion → one multiSelect confirm → tasks.json edits with source/batch/declined+reason → review file annotated with ## Intake result). Reviews panel = batch burn-down lens; document badges intake messages; standing orders cover auto-detect of unprompted dumps. LIVE-FIRED TWICE on scratch haiku: run 1 exposed a real failure (haiku wrote {tasks:[…]} with title/description keys → unvalidated load killed the SDK stream) → hardened (normalizeTasks + survivable translate + shape pinned in the script); run 2 end-to-end PASS — 3 items filed with provenance, 1 declined with reason, file annotated, accepted items then implemented. Captures 02d-review-mode, 10-reviews-panel, live-11-ceremony.

subject: Workbench restructure: attention surface right, reference tabs left
detail: Per the attention-surface ruling (2026-08-18): demote Goal/Scope to a left-rail tab; split "Panels" — QA artifact galleries (image-gallery/markdown/metrics) become a left "Artifacts" tab, while the right workbench carries only needs-your-eyes-now state: question cycles (#15), review intake (#19), and model-pushed live exhibits with attention badges + dismiss. Conversation stays centered. DONE (wave-B merge): Goal + Artifacts are left-rail capabilities (goal first, target icon; artifacts grid icon with amber unseen-updates badge); right workbench is attention-only (Questions tab; auto-flip preserved); localStorage migrated. Verified in 22-state screenshot run.

subject: Codify subagent orchestration: worktrees, bases, merges, gates
detail: Write the doctrine (CLAUDE.md agent-ops section + standing orders line) and fix the mechanics. Rules to encode: worktree isolation is standard for parallel implementation agents (in-tree allowed only for single web-only/read-only work); Clyde creates worktrees itself with EXPLICIT base = current HEAD (observed 2026-08-18: harness worktrees forked from session-start HEAD, missing a commit landed minutes earlier); one merge at a time, server-src merges last (each restarts the dev server); conflict protocol (coordinator resolves, agents never merge); gate = typecheck + fixture QA + live-drive before the merge commit; worktrees pruned after merge. DONE: CLAUDE.md § Agent operations (worktree standard, base pinning, brief contract, merge train, gates, cleanup) + standing-orders Delegate order now points at it. Written from lived mechanics of waves A+B (stale-base footgun, conflict-marker crash-loop avoidance, atomic ff landings).

subject: Agents panel v2: background-agent lifecycle + worktree state
detail: The R8 panel model (running until tool_result) breaks for background agents — the spawn ack lands instantly, so duration froze at 0s while agents ran (user report 2026-08-18). v2: treat backgrounded dispatches as running until a completion signal; liveness heartbeat (e.g. agent transcript/worktree mtime via a server poll); per-agent worktree column (branch, base sha, ahead-count, merged/pending); duration that actually ticks; surface the agent's final report text expandably. Server likely needs a dispatch_update event. DONE (wave-B merge): dispatch_update event parsed from task-notifications (live + backfill paths share the parser); running = no update AND (no result OR spawn ack); ticking durations, last-activity heartbeat (amber >120s), worktree branch chip, expandable final report. Verified in 10b2 capture; rail badge uses the same rule.

subject: Close the last loss window: delta journal + restart choreography
detail: DONE (7c0ada2 journal + 9faa39a follow-through, wave-3 train). Delta journal: streamed text appends to sessions/<id>/deltas-<turnId>.log as it arrives, cleared when the durable assistant_message lands or the turn completes; boot recovery (pure planJournalRecovery in backfill.ts) emits a provisional assistant_message — marked in shared + rendered with a faint 'recovered from stream' chip — only when neither events.jsonl nor the CLI transcript covers the text; sidebar markers stripped before probe and render. Choreography half was already in CLAUDE.md. BONUS same-class fix from ceremony live-fire: tasks.json shape normalization + translate() failures no longer kill the SDK stream. 11 offline checks in qa/backfill-check.mjs (46 total). Limitations noted in-code: 80-char coverage probe; recovered sidebar replies land in main flow.

subject: Model + effort picker in the composer (working, not chrome)
detail: DONE 2262df7 (break-glass wave 2): server half landed on top of the wip-model-picker web half. {model,effort} persist to <sessionDir>/config.json and win over env at boot; set_model validates (4-model allowlist + current-alias passthrough, 5 efforts), rotates the session in place (dispose + new AgentSession, same store, SDK resume) idle-or-disconnected-only, rebroadcasts hello; new_session carries settings forward so the chip never silently reverts. Popover opens mid-turn, Apply waits for idle. Gates: typecheck; 24-state fixture run incl. new 02c-model-picker; live scratch rotation (chip haiku·xhigh→haiku·low, config.json written, rotation log line, round-trip on rotated session). live-drive gained section 6 (effort switch + conversation-recall check) for future full runs.

subject: Responsive layout pass (Design Vision §5)
detail: DONE (a38b5f9, wave-3 train): wide ≥1280 unchanged (resizers + persistence); medium <1280 one auxiliary surface at a time (React matchMedia coordination); narrow <960 capability panels + workbench become overlay drawers with scrim over a full-width conversation; phone <680 condensed top bar (no gauge/cost), rail-only nav, near-full-width drawers. localStorage describes the wide layout only; below-wide toggles are transient. Gates: all fixture captures unchanged at 1440x900 + new 20a-medium/20b-narrow-drawer/20c-phone with behavioral assertions (not just pixels).

subject: Thread pill cleanup: Slack-style affordance, selection-anchored popup
detail: Squeeze-in UI fix (user screenshots 2026-08-19): the hover ⊕ Thread ghost overlapped the message's first line, and the selection 💬 pill spawned at raw cursor coords from a handler on the message div only — unreliable when the drag released outside it, and styled completely differently. Fix: one shared .thread-pill (raised surface, violet accent) for both entry points; hover affordance straddles the message's top-right corner (top:-13px, opaque bg) riding the inter-message whitespace; selection popup anchors to the selection RECT via a document-level mouseup listener (works wherever the drag ends), renders above the selection (below near viewport top), viewport-clamped, dismissed on scroll, selection collapsed on click so the trailing mouseup can't resummon it. Gates: typecheck clean; 24-state fixture run green (04-selection-fab + 04b-message-thread verified by eye). Web-only — no live-drive needed. ROUND 2 (user screenshots): the straddle still clipped the previous message's last line, and :hover swapped the opaque bg for 10%-alpha --thread-soft (text ghosted through). Fix: .msg reserves a 44px right gutter (padding-right) and the affordance became an icon-only 28px circle living in it — zero text overlap at any width; hover tint now layers over the opaque base via background-image.

subject: Blocking exhibits: approve/decline pushes to the attention surface
detail: DONE (train e63e649, agent branch f73b8db, Opus 5 worktree agent). request_review MCP tool blocks exactly like AskUserQuestion: persisted exhibit event → in-memory resolver → JSON {verdict, comment} tool result, no timeout. Shared PanelContent union + one panelContentOf() used by both tools so push_panel and request_review cannot drift. Exhibits workbench tab (attention dot + auto-flip), approve/decline + comment, settled cards collapse to Ruled-on rows; symmetric expiry (server drops resolvers on abort/dispose; reducer expires pending on turn_complete/session_started) so a card never offers a verdict that reaches nobody; WorkBar names the wait ('Clyde needs a verdict on evidence'). Gates: typecheck; 34-state fixture run (26a/26b + behavioral assert that Approve really sends exhibit_response); backfill green; LIVE-FIRED (live-drive §8): haiku pushed a markdown exhibit, approve-with-comment round-tripped — the model echoed 'VERDICT approved — ship it — verified live' — and the settled row rendered (live-13/14 captures). Non-blocking variant + richer content kinds ride #33.

subject: Critic agent type: adversarial verification before acceptance
detail: Formalize a read-only critic subagent (no write tools, separate context): brief template = goal + success criteria from SCOPE, the diff/commits under review, QA artifacts; tasked with finding reasons NOT to accept, never with fixing. Coordinator-dispatched per the 2026-08-18 ruling (extends the CLAUDE.md agent-ops doctrine; the human stays final judge). Doctrine: when it runs (task-close/merge gates, judgment calls), how its verdict surfaces — via #26's blocking exhibits when it believes the bar is met or needs judgment — and verdict→task provenance. Quality bar derives from the goal doc per project type, never a fixed rubric. Standing orders + CLAUDE.md updates included. Depends on #26.

subject: Composer /btw toggle: ephemeral asides via observer query
detail: DONE (train e63e649, agent branch 389892f, Opus 5 worktree agent). observer.ts one-shot query(): haiku at low effort (CLYDE_ASIDE_MODEL overrides), structurally read-only (tools base set Read/Glob/Grep + disallowedTools Bash/Write/Edit/Task/web), settingSources: [], strictMcpConfig, 120s timeout into an error card. Server pre-gathers git log/status + tasks.json + DECISIONS tail so the observer answers instead of orienting. aside/aside_started/aside_result are transient ServerMessages — never events.jsonl, never the queue, no snapshot field; reload drops cards (v1 ruling), reconnect keeps them. /btw toggle (periwinkle, mutually exclusive with ☰ Review), ephemeral card stack above the composer, cost chip per card — session gauge provably untouched. Gates: typecheck; fixture 28a/b/c with asserts (armed submit emits aside and never send_message; no card inside the conversation); backfill green; LIVE-FIRED (live-drive §7, the observer's first real run): answered in 20.9s / $0.02, sha-grounded, document message count unchanged, session stayed idle.

subject: Provenance edges: verdict→task, evidence→task, task→closing commit
detail: Per the edges-over-existing-files ruling (2026-08-18): no graph machinery — add the missing links opportunistically as #26/#27 create them. verdict→task and evidence(exhibit)→task land with those tasks; task→closing commit extends commits.json/tasks.json so a completed task can point at the commit(s) that closed it and the UI can walk goal→conversation→task→decision→commit→evidence→verdict from a task or commit card ('why is this done?'). Rides the wave; do not build standalone infrastructure.

subject: README thesis rewrite: never-read-the-code leads, our density kept
detail: Merge the reviewer's draft into the current README per the 2026-08-18 ruling: lead with the provocative question + the two pillars (craft/rigor quotes preserved near-verbatim), compressed hard — no one-sentence-per-line manifesto cadence; keep the concrete sections, screenshots, and tables; mark unbuilt items as direction; identity line moves inside (amends the identity-line-leads ruling knowingly). SCOPE.md already carries the north star (committed with this prep). Good candidate to write AFTER #26/#27 land so 'the agent proves its work' describes shipped behavior.

subject: Subagent model split: config, agent-type enforcement, picker row
detail: User-directed (2026-08-19): subagents should run on Opus 5 while the main thread stays Fable-class — encoded, not left to inheritance. config.json gains subagentModel (env CLYDE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, default claude-opus-5), carried through New-session like model/effort. Enforcement over convention: the SDK agents option defines an 'implementer' type pinned to the subagent model; #27's 'critic' defaults to the MAIN model (adversarial judgment is what the frontier model is for); standing orders route dispatches through those types so the choice is structural, not a prompt suggestion. Verified: AgentDefinition.model accepts alias or full id ('claude-opus-5'); omitted = inherit. UI: the #25 picker grows a second row (Session / Subagents), same Apply-on-idle rotation; chip shows both when they differ (e.g. fable · xhigh · agents: opus). Rationale: subagents burn most tokens on briefed implementation; Opus 5 is half Fable's price and plenty capable there. Build with #27 in phase 2.

subject: Malleable exhibits: rich content vocabulary + evidence-authoring doctrine
detail: User-directed (2026-08-19): the push vein is too thin — screenshot globs with no framing, no ask, no interactivity. Level up: (a) content kinds shared by push_panel AND request_review (one union): html — a model-authored project file rendered in a sandboxed iframe (bespoke interactives, SVG/HTML plots like train/val loss curves, rich reports); table — columns/rows natively rendered; alongside image-gallery/markdown/metrics. Deliberately NO charting DSL — the model constructs the representation, that IS the malleability. (b) Markdown panels become review-AND-edit: generalize #12's goal-edit mechanics (edit in place → save to file → agent notified) to any pushed markdown panel. (c) Framing mandatory: every push carries title + detail (what this is, what judgment is wanted). (d) Doctrine, the highest-leverage half: rewrite MCP tool descriptions + standing orders to teach evidence AUTHORING with exemplars (loss curves → author SVG/HTML and push; design judgment → screenshot set + the specific ask via blocking request_review; tabular results → table; doc needing the user's pen → editable markdown; an artifact without framing is not evidence). (e) Surface routing doctrine (user, 2026-08-19): the router is the RESPONSE CONTRACT. push_panel = ambient reference → left Artifacts rail: no response expected, continuously updatable, skippable BY DESIGN (standing surfaces like a QA gallery tracking every run). request_review = judgment → right attention surface: always carries the ask, settles with a verdict; BLOCKING when the agent's next action depends on the answer, plus a non-blocking variant (tool resolves 'posted — continue non-gated work'; the verdict steers in as a delivery when the user settles it) for needs-eyes-but-don't-stall. Default to ASKING at judgment-worthy checkpoints — the skippable lane is never for 'I finished something.' The right surface stays high-signal because everything on it awaits a response; nothing there is wallpaper (attention inflation would destroy the badge's meaning). Lifecycle: settled exhibits collapse to outcome rows with verdict→task provenance; durable content can also live as a left artifact; any left artifact can be re-pushed with an ask when judgment is wanted. Sequencing: renderer half = worktree agent C after the A/B train; server schema + doctrine ride the coordinator's phase-2 agentSession pass (one writer on the hotspot); live-fire every kind on scratch incl. a real model-authored HTML plot. Record the ruling in DECISIONS.md when it lands.
